339-677-3480-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-3480-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

822-4091-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Aphetto Alchemist doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-4091-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2292-3129-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2292-3129-5254.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

3764-4871-6495.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.
3764-4871-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4247-6273.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2590-5223-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

774-3147-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting  Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Azorius Chancery's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-5921-5970-6791.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1563-3490-7060-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-7060-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

92-5306-6649.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing the creature with Aettir and Priwen attached, causing you to gain life equal to that creature's toughness.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

4050-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

4321-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4321-4559-4740-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a Food token and a Treasure token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure and Food, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4321-4559-4740-5670.notes: Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2919-4186-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-6752.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4798-5436-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-5436-5632.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

1786-3017-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1786-3017-3591-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

2-4659-5554-6441.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

524-1167-2928.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

1879-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1251-1374-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1251-1374-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

240-526-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.
240-526-5686.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-5011-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-678-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
413-678-4766.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1331-2998-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Gluttonous Troll.
You control at least two Foods.
You have at least two opponents.
1331-2998-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Gluttonous Troll to deal six damage to itself.
Gluttonous Troll dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Gluttonous Troll from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Gluttonous Troll enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Food tokens.
Repeat.

372-3908-4753.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Clever Impersonator returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Spark Double.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clever Impersonator until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

573-1479-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-3703.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1912-3552-4289-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3552-4289-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {W}.
Pay {W} to create a 1/1 Warrior token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1518-1964-1987-4125.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1964-1987-4125.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1987-2427-3448-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
